stories.event: Spain holds a snap general election on Sunday 29 November 2026, called by Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez (PSOE) after Congress rejected his emergency housing reforms; polls are open 09:00–20:00 and the Interior Ministry publishes provisional results from 21:00 CET. In 2023 the PP won 137 seats, PSOE 121, Vox 33 and Sumar 31 (PP+Vox 170, six short of the 176 majority), and Sánchez formed a government with Sumar and regional parties. Final polls published by 23 November had the PP of Alberto Núñez Feijóo first, with a narrowing lead over PSOE (about 0.5 to 6 points), and 15 of 16 private pollsters projected 182–210 seats for PP and Vox together; the state pollster CIS had PSOE about 10 points ahead. In Navarre the PP runs jointly with UPN.
